module.name: Access review
navigation.reviewDescription: Who holds what in this workspace right now.
navigation.activityDescription: What changed and what administrators did, between two dates.
navigation.attestationsDescription: Recorded reviews of this workspace's access.
common.noMatchHint: Change the search to widen the list.
review.title: Access review
review.description: Who holds what in this workspace, read from the authentication core at the moment you asked.
review.denied: You need the access review permission to see who holds what.
review.kpi.extraScopesNote: Grants held on top of the assigned role
review.kpi.providersNote: Ways into this workspace besides a password
review.note: Read live from the authentication core. Nothing on this screen is stored by the access module.
review.cappedNote: This list stops at {count} rows. The counts above still cover the whole workspace.
review.search.label: Search members
review.members.title: Members
review.members.caption: Members of this workspace
review.members.emptyHint: A workspace always keeps one owner, so this list is normally never empty.
review.roles.title: Roles
review.roles.caption: Roles of this workspace
review.roles.emptyHint: The built-in owner and member roles appear here once the workspace is set up.
review.tokens.title: API tokens
review.tokens.caption: Usable API tokens of this workspace
review.tokens.emptyHint: Tokens are issued from the security screen and appear here until they are revoked or expire.
review.tokens.note: Revoked and expired tokens are not access any more, so they are left out. Their issue and revocation stay in the activity report.
review.providers.title: Identity providers
review.providers.caption: Identity providers of this workspace
review.providers.emptyHint: Members sign in with a password until a provider is configured.
review.providers.note: Which member is linked to which provider is not readable yet, so this lists the providers and the rules by which people join through them.
review.error.load: The review could not be loaded.
activity.title: Access activity
activity.description: What changed between two dates, and what administrators did, read from the platform audit trail.
activity.denied: You need the access review permission to see this activity.
activity.diff.title: Changes in this period
activity.activity.title: Administrative activity
activity.caption: Recorded changes of this workspace
activity.reversed: The end of the period is before its start.
activity.note: The trail is read in pages, newest first. Legal holds and erasures live in the audit module's own trail and are not part of this report yet.
activity.emptyHint: Widen the period, or change the report, to see more.
activity.activity.emptyTitle: No administrative activity in this period
activity.column.subject: Subject
activity.error.load: The report could not be loaded.
attestations.title: Attestations
attestations.description: Every recorded review of this workspace's access, with the counts as they stood.
attestations.denied: You need the access review permission to see the attestations.
attestations.table.title: Recorded attestations
attestations.caption: Attestations of this workspace
attestations.emptyHint: Record one from the review screen once you have been through it.
attestations.note: An attestation is never edited or removed. A later review is recorded beside it.
attestations.error.load: The attestations could not be loaded.
attest.title: Record an attestation
attest.subtitle: The counts are taken from the review as it stands now.
attest.noteHelp: What the next reviewer should know. At most 2000 characters.
attest.evidence: Recorded as: {members} members, {scopes} scopes beyond a role, {tokens} usable tokens.
attest.error.record: The attestation could not be recorded.
error.code.INVALID_INPUT: The period is not a pair of calendar dates.
error.code.RANGE_REVERSED: The end of the period is before its start.
error.code.RANGE_TOO_LONG: A period covers at most 366 days.
error.code.CURSOR_INVALID: That page is no longer valid. Load the report again.
error.code.CSRF_REJECTED: Your session proof was refused. Reload the page and try again.
